response:
I'm so sorry you're carrying all of this—the grief of losing your child, the pain of feeling your marriage slipping away, and the hurt of infidelity on top of it all. That's an enormous weight, and it makes sense that you're willing to forgive if it means keeping your family together.

Grief like yours doesn't have a timeline, and anniversaries can reopen wounds in powerful ways. It also sounds like there may be deeper, unresolved pain that has been affecting your relationship for years. Couples counseling could provide a safe space to work through this together, and individual support for each of you might also help. A licensed therapist can help you both navigate this in a way that honors your loss while addressing what's happening now.

Whatever happens, you deserve support through this too. Consider reaching out to a counselor or a grief support group. You don't have to carry this alone.
